gap: Known redacted strings must be absent from all customer outputs, attachments, thumbnails, metadata and indexes. Current internal draft is unredacted and refuses redaction requests.

candidates.name: Presidio
candidates.potential: Offline text entity identification and explicit anonymization operators; structured data helpers.
candidates.scope_limit: Detection is probabilistic/rule/model dependent and does not alone establish no remaining sensitive data. Whole report-package surfaces require separate deterministic canary checks and operator review.

candidates.name: PyMuPDF
candidates.license_observed: AGPL or commercial alternatives; distribution decision pending
candidates.potential: PDF redaction application plus document scrub controls for metadata, thumbnails, embedded files and other surfaces.
candidates.scope_limit: PDF-specific; rectangles/content/image options and non-incremental clean output need dedicated validation, does not cover arbitrary binary files.

candidates.name: ExifTool
candidates.potential: Existing metadata inventory engine may help inspect media output.
candidates.scope_limit: No text/image pixel redaction. Documentation fetch blocked403 this review; do not treat unverified metadata stripping as safe PDF redaction.

implementation_decision: No library alone satisfies full package acceptance. Preserve existing release refusal. Start with explicit output-format and surface policy, separately generated derived outputs, source unchanged checks, canaries and review; only integrate a component after scoped synthetic proof and exact version/license pins.
no_case_data_transmitted: Research queries contain feature/library names only; no acquired evidence uploaded.
